plan.title: Reject proposal with empty Procurement Type

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly in Master QCS.
Ensure eRFX project functionality is enabled as required by the case configuration.
Enter the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate all 10 requested units to Vendor B.
Verify one line is selected, Vendor B is the sole awarded vendor, and the proposal value is 10 × 90 = 900.
Open the proposal form after completing the allocation.

args.goal: Fill every required proposal field except Procurement Type, leaving Procurement Type empty, and stop on the proposal form.

steps.note: Complete the proposal form while deliberately leaving the required Procurement Type field blank.
Attempt to submit the incomplete proposal.
Verify Procurement Type is highlighted as required and submission is refused.
Confirm the proposal remains unsubmitted on the proposal form.
